messages.title: How do you like the new look?
messages.message: ChurchCRM 7.1.x shipped a redesigned UI — we'd love your feedback.

messages.title: We need your help — what should ChurchCRM build next?
messages.message: Your staff work in ChurchCRM every day: keeping people and groups up to date, recording giving, planning events. We are deciding which feature to build next, and your church's day-to-day experience should drive that choice. Vote on the topics we are considering and tell us how your staff do the work today — the most-needed features get built first.

messages.title: ChurchCRM 7.8.7 is available
messages.message: Your ChurchCRM is on 7.8.1. Version 7.8.7 is available with security updates and fixes. Support covers only the latest version, so please upgrade when you can — and back up first.
